411901.name: Large Caliber Rifle
411901.description: Fires large caliber rifles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. These rifles can be destroyed and will no longer fire once they are gone.

411902.name: Big Crystal Missile
411902.description: Launches a huge crystal missile that can be intercepted with a certain number of hits.

411903.name: Crystal Light
411903.description: The sinister crystal exudes menace, inflicting a debuff on all Nikkes.

411904.name: Plasma Laser
411904.description: Fires a plasma laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke and temporarily increasing her Charge Time.

411905.name: Random Crystal Laser
411905.description: Fires lasers from the crystal, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
